title: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not restrict the content type of its lightbox shortcode,…
description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin versions prior to 7.9.1 contain a vulnerability in the lightbox shortcode that allows users with contributor role or higher to inject unsanitized HTML content from attacker-controlled servers. This leads to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) when other users open the lightbox.
